name: MFL India Limited
about: MFL India Limited, a transport and logistics company, provides logistics and supply chain services in India. It owns a fleet of mixed high-volume/heavy-weight cargo carriers, as well as high-capacity trucks and trailers. The company also provides freight management, cargo brokerage, and inter-modal services; and ocean, air, and ground transportation services. In addition, it offers warehousing and supply chain management services. The company transports retail store merchandise, 2- wheeler motorcycles / scooters, consumer products, fast-moving consumer goods, and other manufactured and grocery products. MFL India Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Delhi, India.
